state: Silent hardware-trial candidate; package only after exact-ELF staging checks. Not installed.
base: NAMLNK05 non-fused A2 Lite, stock chain, bypass suspension and working-set preparation
output: Always zero; no audio playback or host audio APIs

measurement.counter: Read-only DWT CYCCNT; raw 32-bit cycles, no conversion to microseconds
measurement.enclosed_entry: Original stock audio IRQ body at 0x11d94
enclosed_work: Stock DMA status helper, acknowledgements and buffer selection
Replacement audio callback including validation, housekeeping and output clearing
Input conversion, complete stock effect chain and NAM
Existing DSP timer/accounting and stock sample-counter update
excluded: Hardware interrupt release latency and exception entry/return
New wrapper prologue and bookkeeping before the first timestamp
New wrapper bookkeeping and epilogue after the second timestamp
Foreground effect loading, USB model validation and other thread work
measurement.known_reset_hook: The exact stock delay CYCCNT reset at 0xbe48 is preserved and increments a reset epoch
not_proven: CPU frequency, independent clock calibration, complete hardware deadline or DMA underrun detection
Absence of other counter writers, clock changes or positive counter discontinuities
Runtime overhead, cache behavior or timing of the diagnostic build on physical hardware

patches.0x205a8: Replace only the stock audio IRQ trampoline target; original IRQ body and vector table remain intact
patches.0xbe48: Replace two instructions with BL; hook executes both original instructions and preserves live registers and flags

status_protocol.transport: Existing bounded NP read request and eight-byte 7-bit status response
status_protocol.page_12: Latch one coherent snapshot; return magic 0x54494d31 on success
status_protocol.snapshot: Three bounded seqlock attempts; frozen until another page-12 request. No IRQ masking or processing pause. Single diagnostic reader required.

errors.2: Three snapshot attempts interrupted; previous snapshot invalidated

flags.1: Counter disabled at entry or CTRL changed during the span
flags.2: Known stock reset occurred during the span
flags.4: Zero or ambiguous span of at least half the counter range

initialization: New BSS state is appended after the existing NAM model/receiver state and cleared by the stock runtime on cold and warm starts
mac_test_scope: CPU simulation verifies code placement, IRQ/ABI behavior, synthetic-counter math, status snapshots, stock DSP switching and independent NAM reference accuracy. It cannot measure physical M7 real-time performance.
distribution: Source archive excludes proprietary NUX binaries and firmware images. Local staged trial retains stock startup, drivers and effects; not fully open-source firmware.

headroom.placement: After the stock master-volume wrapper, inside the unchanged DSP timer guard
headroom.gain_rounding: Float32 division, followed by one representable step toward zero, including subnormal gains
headroom.above_ceiling: One common attenuation for both channels, recomputed every block
headroom.nonfinite: Clear both internal outputs and latch processing fault
headroom.limits: Immediate block gain recovery; no release smoothing or listening assessment. Not a playable-output release.
